fact: Mauritania's data protection authority received on 24 May 2023 from the minister for digital transformation a draft bill on the right of access to public information and its use, and on 22 September 2023 gave a favourable opinion on condition of deleting personal-data provisions.
title: مداولة رقم 006-2023 حول مسودة مشروع قانون يتعلق بالحق في النفاذ إلى المعلومة العمومية واستخدامها
